attributes.powers:
For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill +1d6.

On a combat check by a character at your location, discard this card to add 1d4 and the Fire trait.
attributes.recharge: After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 7 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
